# Mohamed Attauabi

Mohamed Attauabi is a Reservelæge (reserve physician) at Region Hovedstaden who serves as a member of the steering committee for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease. [^src1] [^src2]

Attauabi's role places him within the broader structure of DANIBD's governance, which encompasses clinical specialists, nurses, and patient representatives across Denmark's five regions, along with epidemiological and data management support from RKKP. [^src1] [^src2] His participation reflects the multi-disciplinary clinical leadership required to oversee a national registry that tracked treatment for 33,381 inflammatory bowel disease patients across Danish regions between October 2022 and September 2023, with Region Hovedstaden serving as the largest treating region during that period. [^src1]

By 2024, Attauabi held a doctoral degree (ph.d.), underscoring the research credentials expected of steering committee members. [^src2]
